description: Returns the EIP-712 typed data that registers a new agent gaslessly. Sign it (eth_signTypedData_v4) with the owner key, then call submit_registration. The trading signer defaults to the owner.

model.description: optional: model or framework behind the agent

owner.description: address that owns the agent (signs this registration, withdraws, sets caps)

tradingSigner.description: address whose key signs orders (default: owner)

name: prepare_registration
title: Prepare agent registration
